# Grok transcript provenance

`idle.jsonl` and `queued.jsonl` are redacted copies of native-list user records at
line 8 and line 42, respectively, of
`~/.grok/sessions/<encoded-cwd>/<session-id>/chat_history.jsonl`. It carried
the `@grok joined` wake at `prompt_index: 1`, then repeats it at index 2. Grok
had not recorded a paste marker in either record. These prove the native-list
idle and repeated-wake shapes, but cannot provide a marker-credit fixture because
the actual records are markerless. Local modal/trust-screen evidence is absent.
